mechanism: same frozen outline and requirements; treatment adds frozen responsibility only; shared sequential session within each arm; independent sessions across arms/repeats

evaluation.unit: semantic definition/mechanism explanation with chapter and exact sentence evidence; keyword counts only locate candidates
evaluation.harmful: full re-explanation outside owner without new analysis value; introductions/conclusions short summaries and required scientific qualifications are allowed
evaluation.gate: reduce harmful repetition on dev and both heldout pairs; retain mechanism, limitations, correct terminology/citations; no new unsupported facts or partial escalation; total SDK cost <= baseline +20%; no substantial content compression to claim improvement

heldoutPolicy: Freeze production candidate and prompts before first heldout dispatch; no heldout-informed tuning; retain all failed/unfavorable outputs; controlled/manual contracts test execution separately from planner smoke; no E2E claim
